base_predictor: Ridge over matched Qwen3-VL prompt+Flux4B probe embedding

retrieval_modes.visual_delta: cosine of matched minus text-only Qwen3-VL embeddings; proxy for image-specific evidence, not an explicit deficit
retrieval_modes.joint_centered: joint embedding cosine after subtracting the train mean
retrieval_modes.visual_delta_centered: visual-delta cosine after subtracting the train mean
retrieval_modes.prompt_visual_centered_half: 0.5 raw prompt cosine + 0.5 centered visual-delta cosine

method: QEval Ridge prediction + beta times mean retrieved QEval-Ridge training residual
notes: All retrieval indices contain only Ridge-training prompts.
The query probe image is matched to its own prompt; no target labels enter retrieval.
The result is an information-value preview because Qwen3-VL evaluator compute remains unpriced.
A true deficit-aware RAG would retrieve structured failure descriptions, which are not present in the current cache.
